agreedBellaRule.keep: Preserve current catalogue, suffix parsing and name output exactly. Do not humanize unknown tokens or replace first-name selection with a new heuristic.
agreedBellaRule.integration: Use the existing standalone Qt Core/C++17 AvidEffects::lookup. Its Hit.name supplies Effect from the same call that supplies Category/Sequence. Derive after final selected Type/Clip Name and temporarily reuse within the same selected master/name scope; recompute if selected inputs change.
agreedBellaRule.retention: Keep needed owned QString result values and compact required context. Normal Qt implicit sharing permits associated-row reuse without retaining the MDB read buffer or full per-label source histories.
agreedBellaRule.noExtraRead: No separate Effect decoder, additional MDB graph walk or header read solely for this name-derived label.
agreedBellaRule.optionalRefactor: A private parse-name helper could separate token/sequence/instance extraction if future formats require it. Preserve exact comma/plus precedence and range handling; this is not required work, a new parser design or a measured speed gain.
agreedBellaRule.separate: Effect Sequence detailed rules remain open. Matching does not establish Type, Precompute Category, actual effect identity or timeline membership.
